Rashi on Eruvin 93a:10:1.english: That is not the reason - That the partition makes this perimeter like the vineyard.

Rashi on Eruvin 93a:10:2.hebrew: הכי גרסינן ארבע אמות דלהדי כרם עבודת הכרם - וכיון דצריך לו, הוי כרם עצמו:
Rashi on Eruvin 93a:10:2.english: This is the version we read: Four cubits that are adjacent to the vineyard are the work area of the vineyard - And since [the vineyard] needs it, it is [considered as] the vineyard itself.

Rashi on Eruvin 93a:10:3.hebrew: כיון דלא מזדרען - משום דמקלקל ליה לכותל אבנים, שהמחרישה מעלה עפר תיחוח, והכותל נופל כשאין תחתיו קרקע חזקה. והכי תנן בבבא בתרא (דף יט.): מרחיקין את הזרע כו':
Rashi on Eruvin 93a:10:3.english: Since they cannot be sown - Because [plowing] damages the stone wall, as the plow turns up loose soil and the wall collapses when there is no firm ground beneath it. And so we learned in Bava Batra (19a): “One must distance seeds, etc.”

Rashi on Eruvin 93a:10:4.hebrew: אפקורי מפקר להו - לגבי גדר, ולא מצטרפי להדי האי דפייש לאחשובי, דלא ליבטיל לגבי כרם:
Rashi on Eruvin 93a:10:4.english: He renounces ownership of them - With respect to the fence; and they do not combine with that which remains to be considered significant, so that it would not be nullified relative to the vineyard.

Rashi on Eruvin 93a:11:1.hebrew: ג' קרפיפות זה בצד זה - כגון שהיו מהלכין בדרך, והקיפו ג' קרפיפות לדירה במחיצה של שתי, כגון של קנים, או של ערב, כגון חבלים, שלא התירו בו ליחיד אלא בית סאתים, כדמפרש בפ"ק (דף טז:): דשיירא מותרת להקיף כל צרכן בקנים ובחבלים לדירה, אבל יחיד יותר מבית סאתים — לא, אא"כ עשה שתי וערב, מחיצה קיימת:
Rashi on Eruvin 93a:11:1.english: Three enclosures alongside one another - For example, where they were traveling on the road and enclosed three enclosures for dwelling with a partition of warp [alone], such as of reeds, or of woof [alone], such as ropes, in which [case] they permitted for an individual only [an area of] two se'ah, as is explained in the first chapter (daf 16b): that a caravan is permitted to enclose all they require with reeds and ropes for dwelling, but an individual [may] not [enclose] more than two se'ah unless he made [both] warp and woof, [forming] a durable partition.

Rashi on Eruvin 93a:11:2.hebrew: ושנים החיצונים מגופפין וכו' - שהחיצונים רחבים מן האמצעי, והוא פרוץ לשניהם במלואו, וגיפופיהן עודפין עליו: (*):(*)
Rashi on Eruvin 93a:11:2.english: And the two outer ones have flanks, etc. - For the outer [enclosures] are wider than the middle one, and it is breached along its full width to both of them, and their flanks extend beyond it. (*):(*)

Rashi on Eruvin 93a:11:3.hebrew: ויחיד בזה ויחיד בזה [ויחידי בזה] נעשו שיירא ונותנין להן כל צרכן - דאמרינן: דיורי גדולים בקטן, ונמצאו שלשתן באמצעי. האמצעי מצרפן, ומותר אמצעי זה — כל שהוא גדול — היקף במחיצה של שתי או של ערב, וכגון שעירבו:
Rashi on Eruvin 93a:11:3.english: And one in this and one in that [and one in this] become a caravan, and one provides them with all that they require - For we say [the principle that] the residents of the larger [enclosures are considered to dwell] in the smaller [enclosure], and [thus] all three of them are found in the middle [enclosure]. The middle [enclosure] combines them, and this middle [enclosure] is permitted — however large it is — [as] an enclosure with a partition of [only] warp or of [only] woof; and [this is in a case] where they made an eruv.

Rashi on Eruvin 93a:12:1.hebrew: אמצעי מגופף וחיצונים אין מגופפין - שהוא רחב מהן, והן פתוחין לו במלואו, ולדידיה לא הוי מילואו: (*):(*)
Rashi on Eruvin 93a:12:1.english: The middle [enclosure] has side projections and the outer ones do not have side projections - In that it is wider than them, and they open into it across their entire width, whereas for it, it is not its entire width. (*):(*)

Rashi on Eruvin 93a:12:2.hebrew: אין נותנין להם - אלא בית סאתים לכל קרפף, שהרי אין שלשה דיורין באחד, דדיורי אמצעי בחיצונים, וזיל להכי — תרי הוא דאיכא, ובאמצעי ליכא אלא חד. ואם אחד מהן יותר מבית סאתים — הוא אסור; ואם אמצעי יותר מבית סאתים — כולן אסורין, שהרי הן פרוצין לרשות האסורה:
Rashi on Eruvin 93a:12:2.english: One does not provide them - other than [an area of] two beit se’ah for each enclosure, for there are not three residents in any single [enclosure], as the resident of the middle [enclosure] is [considered to be] in the outer ones, and if you go this way, there are only two, and in the middle [enclosure] there is only one. And if one of them is larger than two beit se’ah, it is forbidden; and if the middle [enclosure] is larger than two beit se’ah, all of them are forbidden, since they are breached into a forbidden domain.

Rashi on Eruvin 93a:12:3.hebrew: שנים הוו כיחיד - עד דהוי שיירא, דהיינו שלשה:
Rashi on Eruvin 93a:12:3.english: Two are like an individual - until there is a caravan, that is, three [people].

Rashi on Eruvin 93a:13:1.hebrew: איבעיא להו - אמצעי מגופף ולא חיצונים, ושני אנשים באמצעי, ויחיד בזה ויחיד בזה — מאי:
Rashi on Eruvin 93a:13:1.english: A dilemma was raised before them - [In a case where] the middle [enclosure] is flanked and not the outer ones, and [there are] two people in the middle [one], and an individual in this [one] and an individual in that [one] — what [is the law]?

Rashi on Eruvin 93a:13:2.hebrew: אי להכא נפקי כו' - והנך דאמצעי, הואיל ושניהם שולטין לכאן ולכאן, שדי תרוייהו להכא ותרוייהו להכא, ולישתרו שני קרפיפות החיצונים היקף בכל צרכן:
Rashi on Eruvin 93a:13:2.english: If they exit to here, etc. - And [as for] those of the middle [enclosure], since both of them have access to here and to there, cast both of them to here and both of them to there, and let both outer enclosures be permitted an enclosure according to all their needs.

Rashi on Eruvin 93a:14:1.hebrew: או דילמא - כולי האי לא מקילינן, דנישדינהו להכא ולהכא; וה"נ לא אמרינן, דנירמינהו תרוייהו לחד ולמישרי מיהא חד מן החיצונים בכל צורכו — דמסתמא הכי ניחא ליה טפי: דליהוי חד להכא וחד להכא, דלא ניהוי אלא תרי בכל חד, דרווח להו לתשמישתייהו, מלמהוי תלתא בחד ובאינך לא ניהוי אלא חד:
Rashi on Eruvin 93a:14:1.english: Or perhaps - We do not apply leniency to such an extent that we cast them to here and to there; and likewise we do not say that we should assign both of them to one [outer enclosure] and permit at least one of the outer [enclosures] with all its requirements, because presumably it is more preferable to him that one be here and one be there, so that there will be only two in each one — which leaves them more room for their use — rather than having three in one while in the other there will only be one.

Rashi on Eruvin 93a:15:1.hebrew: וא' באמצעי - והוא שליט על החיצונים:
Rashi on Eruvin 93a:15:1.english: And one in the middle - And he has access to the outer [enclosures].

Rashi on Eruvin 93a:15:2.hebrew: וכל היכא דנפיק תלתא הוו - ושדיא להכא ולהכא, או שדיא מיהא לחד מינייהו, ונישתרי חד מן החיצונים בכל צרכי היקף:
Rashi on Eruvin 93a:15:2.english: And wherever he exits, they are three - And [we] assign [him] to here and to there, or [we] assign [him] at least to one of them, and let one of the outer [enclosures] be permitted with all the requirements of an enclosure.

Rashi on Eruvin 93a:15:3.hebrew: או דילמא אימר להכא או להכא - ולא ידעינן להי מנייהו. הלכך, אפילו חד נמי לא יהבינן ליה כל צרכו:
Rashi on Eruvin 93a:15:3.english: Or perhaps, say [he exits] to here or to here - And we do not know to which of them [he will exit]. Therefore, even to one [of the enclosures] we also do not give all its needs.

Rashi on Eruvin 93a:17:1.english: And the halakha is [that] our dilemmas [are resolved] leniently - These questions of ours [are decided] leniently.

Rashi on Eruvin 93a:1:1.hebrew: סיכך על גבי אכסדרה שיש לה פצימין - שתי דפנות שיש לה כהלכתה לאורכה, ועשויה כמבוי, ובדופן שלישית ורביעית קבועין עמודים לקרני הזויות, ויש להם טפח: (*):(*)
Rashi on Eruvin 93a:1:1.english: If one placed roofing on top of a portico that has doorposts - The two walls that it has are according to the halakhah along its length, and it is configured like an alleyway; and on the third and fourth sides, posts are fixed at the corners, and they have [a width of] a handbreadth. (*):(*)

Rashi on Eruvin 93a:1:2.hebrew: כשירה - דתנן (סוכה ו.): שתים כהלכתן, ושלישית אפילו טפח:
Rashi on Eruvin 93a:1:2.english: [It is] valid - For we learned in a mishna (Sukkah 6b): Two [walls must be] in their proper manner, and a third [wall may be] even a handbreadth.

Rashi on Eruvin 93a:1:3.hebrew: ואילו השוה את פצימיה - שבנה ב' מחיצות בתוכה אצל מחיצות הראשונות, ונמצאו פצימיה עומדין בין שתי' המחיצות מכאן ובין שתי מחיצות מכאן, ובתוך האכסדרה אינן נראין:
Rashi on Eruvin 93a:1:3.english: However, if he evened its doorposts - That he built two partitions inside it adjacent to the original partitions, so that its doorposts turn out to be standing between the two partitions on this side and between two partitions on that side, and from inside the portico they are not visible.

Rashi on Eruvin 93a:1:4.hebrew: פסולה - דאין לה אלא ב' מחיצות:
Rashi on Eruvin 93a:1:4.english: [It is] invalid - For it has only two partitions.

Rashi on Eruvin 93a:2:1.hebrew: לדידי כשירה - דפליגי עלך בהא מילתא לקמן בפירקין, דאפילו אין לה שום מחיצה, אמרינן פי תקרה יורד וסותם. דסתם אכסדרה תחובין קורות למעלה מעמוד לעמוד, שעליהן נותנים את התקרה, והנך קורות יש להם פה, דהיינו חודה, שאינה עגולה אלא מרובעת:
Rashi on Eruvin 93a:2:1.english: In my opinion, [it is] valid - For [they] disagree with you regarding this matter later in our chapter, [holding] that even if it has no partition at all, we say [that] the edge of the ceiling descends and closes [it]. For [in] a standard portico, beams are inserted above from pillar to pillar, upon which they place the ceiling, and those beams have a "mouth" — that is, its edge — in that [the beam] is not round, but squared.

Rashi on Eruvin 93a:2:2.hebrew: לדידך - נמי דאמרת פסולה, אין כאן מחיצה לאיסור, דהכא היינו טעמא: שסילק מכאן את הפצימין ואת מחיצות הראשונות ע"י מחיצות הללו, והעמידה על אלו לבדן:
Rashi on Eruvin 93a:2:2.english: According to your opinion - Even according to you who say [that it is] invalid, there is no partition [acting] to prohibit here, for here, this is the reason: that he removed the doorposts and the original partitions from here by means of these partitions, and established it upon these alone.

Rashi on Eruvin 93a:3:1.hebrew: חציו מקורה - מכוסה בגג חלק, כעין תקרת עלייה:
Rashi on Eruvin 93a:3:1.english: Half of which is roofed - Covered with a flat roof, like the ceiling of an upper story.

Rashi on Eruvin 93a:3:2.english: [If there are] vines here - Under the roofing.

Rashi on Eruvin 93a:3:3.hebrew: מותר לזרוע כאן - חוץ לקירוי מיד, ואין צריך להרחיק, דפי תקרה יורד וסותם, והוי מחיצה מבדלת ביניהם:
Rashi on Eruvin 93a:3:3.english: It is permitted to sow here - Immediately outside the roofing, and one does not need to distance [the seeds], for the edge of the roof descends and closes [the space], and it is a partition dividing between them.

Rashi on Eruvin 93a:4:1.hebrew: השוה את קרויו - שקירה כל הבית — אסור, אא"כ הרחיק:
Rashi on Eruvin 93a:4:1.english: [If] he evened its roofing - That he roofed the entire house — [it is] prohibited unless he distanced [the crops].

Rashi on Eruvin 93a:4:2.hebrew: סילוק מחיצות - שהשלמה זו סילק פי תקרה, ואין כאן מבדיל:
Rashi on Eruvin 93a:4:2.english: Removal of partitions - For [by] this completion [of the roof], he removed the edge of the ceiling, and there is no divider here.

Rashi on Eruvin 93a:5:1.english: By means of Rav Shemaya - He instructed him to give this response to Abaye:

Rashi on Eruvin 93a:5:2.hebrew: להקל ולהחמיר - פעמים שהמחיצה מתרת לענין כלאים, ופעמים שהיא אוסרת:
Rashi on Eruvin 93a:5:2.english: To be lenient and to be stringent - There are times when the partition permits with regard to diverse kinds [kilayim], and there are times when it prohibits.

Rashi on Eruvin 93a:5:3.hebrew: עד עיקר המחיצה - כלומר, עד יסוד מחיצה, סמוך ודבוק למחיצה:
Rashi on Eruvin 93a:5:3.english: Until the base of the partition - That is to say, up to the foundation of the partition, adjacent and attached to the partition.

Rashi on Eruvin 93a:6:1.hebrew: היה משוך - כרם רחוק מן הגדר אחת עשרה אמה, וכ"ש פחות:
Rashi on Eruvin 93a:6:1.english: [If the vineyard] was distanced - [The] vineyard was distanced from the fence eleven cubits, and all the more so [if it was distanced] less [than that].

Rashi on Eruvin 93a:6:2.hebrew: לא יביא זרע - בין כרם לגדר, וטעמא מפרש לקמן:
Rashi on Eruvin 93a:6:2.english: One may not bring seed - Between the vineyard and the fence; and the reason is explained further on.

Rashi on Eruvin 93a:7:1.hebrew: אותבן ממתני' - דאלימא לאקשויי טפי מברייתא:
Rashi on Eruvin 93a:7:1.english: Raise an objection against us from a mishna - For it is more forceful to raise an objection [from it] than from a baraita.

Rashi on Eruvin 93a:7:2.english: A clearing in a vineyard - It is explained below.

Rashi on Eruvin 93a:7:3.hebrew: י"ב אמות - לקמן מפרש טעמא:
Rashi on Eruvin 93a:7:3.english: Twelve cubits - Later on, [the Gemara] explains the reason.

Rashi on Eruvin 93a:9:1.english: Perimeter - [That is,] all around, like circle dances.

Rashi on Eruvin 93a:9:2.hebrew: אין שם שש עשרה אמה כו' - לפי שיש כרם מכאן ומכאן, וצריך להרחיק וליתן ארבע אמות לכרם לכל צד לעבודתו — כמלא בקר וכליו, שהיו חורשין בשוורין. ואם נשארו ח' אמות באמצע, שאם באת לחלקו לכאן ולכאן יש ד' אמות לכל חלק — חשיבי ולא בטילי, ולא אתי כרם דהאי גיסא ומבטל פלגא, וכרם מהאי גיסא ומבטל פלגא:
Rashi on Eruvin 93a:9:2.english: If there are not sixteen cubits, etc. - Because there is a vineyard on this side and on that side, and one must distance [foreign seeds] and provide four cubits to the vineyard on each side for its cultivation — the span of an ox and its implements, as they would plow with oxen. And if eight cubits remain in the middle, such that if you were to divide it to this side and to that side there are four cubits for each portion — they are significant and are not nullified, and the vineyard on this side does not come and nullify [its] half, and the vineyard on that side [does not come and] nullify [its] half.

Rashi on Eruvin 93a:9:3.english: Its requisite work area - Four cubits on each side.

Rashi on Eruvin 93a:9:4.hebrew: י"ב אמות - לקמן מפרש טעמא:
Rashi on Eruvin 93a:9:4.english: Twelve cubits - Below, the Gemara explains the reason.

Tosafot on Eruvin 93a:15:1.hebrew: שנים בזה ושנים בזה - ולא דמי לתשעה בקטנה ויחיד בגדולה, דהכא איכא טעמא כדאמר: דנפיק להכא ולהכא:
Tosafot on Eruvin 93a:15:1.english: Two in this [enclosure] and two in that [enclosure] - And it is not similar to [the case of] nine in the small [enclosure] and one in the large [enclosure], for here there is a reason, as [the Gemara] states: that he exits to here and to there.

Tosafot on Eruvin 93a:1:1.hebrew: סיכך על גבי אכסדרה שיש לה פצימין - אין נראה כמו שפירש בקונטרס, שיש שתי דפנות לאורכה כמבוי מפולש; דבפ"ק דסוכה (דף יח:) מהדר ליה אביי לרבא: "בהא מודינא לך, משום דהוי כמבוי מפולש", ולא אמרינן פי תקרה יורד וסותם. אלא יש לפרש דהוי כמין גאם, ואין להאריך:
Tosafot on Eruvin 93a:1:1.english: If one placed roofing on top of a portico that has doorposts - It does not seem [correct] as explained in the Kuntres [Rashi], that there are two walls along its length like an open alleyway, for in the first chapter of Sukkah (18b), Abaye replies to Rava: "In this [case] I agree with you, because it is like an open alleyway," and we do not say [that] the edge of the ceiling descends and seals. Rather, it should be explained that it is [shaped] like [the letter] gamma, and there is no need to elaborate.

Tosafot on Eruvin 93a:3:1.hebrew: חציו מקורה גפנים כאן מותר לזרוע כאן - משום פי תקרה. אע"ג דלענין שבת לא אמרינן פי תקרה לשמואל אלא כשיש ד' מחיצות, לגירסת רבינו חננאל ור"ת — [מ"מ] יש לחלק בין כלאים לשבת, כדמשמע בפ"ק (דף יא.). והא דקא אמרינן לעיל דקטנה הוי כפתחה של גדולה אף לכלאים — מיתורא דקתני במתני' "מפני שהיא כפתחה של גדולה", משמע ליה: לכל מילי הויא כפתחה:
Tosafot on Eruvin 93a:3:1.english: [If] half of it is roofed, [if there are] vines here, it is permitted to sow there - [This is] because of [the principle that] the edge of the roof [descends and closes it off]. Even though with regard to Shabbat we do not say [the principle of] the edge of the roof according to Shmuel unless there are four partitions, according to the reading of Rabbeinu Chananel and Rabbeinu Tam — [nevertheless,] one can differentiate between kilayim and Shabbat, as is implied in the first chapter (11a). And as for that which we said earlier, that the small [courtyard] is considered like the entrance of the large one even for kilayim — [this is derived] from the superfluous phrasing taught in the Mishnah, "because it is like the entrance of the large one," which implied to [the Gemara that] for all matters it is considered like its entrance.
